name: Influenza-Like Illness (ILI) Pattern
description: An acute respiratory infection constellation characterized by fever, cough, and generalized constitutional symptoms such as myalgia, fatigue, and rapid onset.
differential_considerations: Common Cold (usually lacks high fever and severe myalgias)

name: Acute Viral Upper Respiratory Infection (Common Cold) Pattern
description: A mild, self-limited viral infection of the upper respiratory tract primarily manifesting as nasal congestion, sore throat, sneezing, and low-grade or absent fever.
differential_considerations: Streptococcal Pharyngitis (severe sore throat, exudates, high fever)

name: Allergic Rhinitis Pattern
description: An IgE-mediated inflammatory response of the nasal mucosa triggered by allergen exposure, characterized by sneezing, clear rhinorrhea, and ocular/nasal pruritus without fever.
differential_considerations: Early Viral Upper Respiratory Tract Infection

name: Migraine-Type Headache Pattern
description: A neurovascular primary headache disorder marked by recurrent, throbbing, typically unilateral head pain associated with sensory hypersensitivities (photophobia, phonophobia) and autonomic features (nausea).
clinical_features: Unilateral throbbing or pulsating cranial pain

name: Acute Gastroenteritis Pattern
description: Acute inflammation of the mucous membranes of the stomach and intestines resulting in rapid-onset watery diarrhea, nausea, vomiting, and abdominal cramping.
differential_considerations: Appendicitis / Acute Abdomen (severe focal right lower quadrant pain)

name: Uncomplicated Lower Urinary Tract Infection (Cystitis) Pattern
description: Bacterial colonization and inflammation localized to the bladder and urethra presenting with irritative voiding symptoms without flank pain or systemic fever.

name: Suspected Upper Urinary Tract Infection / Pyelonephritis Pattern
description: Ascending urinary infection extending into the renal parenchyma characterized by lower urinary tract symptoms accompanied by flank pain and systemic fever.
differential_considerations: Lower UTI with Musculoskeletal Back Pain

name: Severe Influenza-Like Illness with High Constitutional Burden
description: A higher-severity subset of influenza-like syndrome characterized by very high fever, severe myalgia, and marked prostration.
